name: Forge Nano Holdings Inc.
summary: Forge Nano Holdings Inc. develops and manufactures atomic layer deposition equipment and provides surface engineering solutions for materials at both research and commercial scales. The company provides atomic layer deposition equipment and solutions for applying precision coatings to materials such as semiconductor wafers, ultra-high surface area powders, filters, membranes, and optical elements. It offers proprietary ALD platforms and tools, including Prometheus, Theia, Pandora, and Lithos systems, for lab-scale and commercial-scale applications.
